      "band": "P2",

      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a regression where bitcoin-cli -rpcclienttimeout=0 fails immediately on macOS with 'Could not connect to the server'. The PR resolves an EINVAL error from select() triggered by a 5-year timeout mapping introduced in #34342."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has Utils/log/libs label and modifies src/util/sock.cpp and src/util/sock.h.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes socket primitive behavior by capping Sock::WaitMany timeouts to avoid OS-specific select() limitations. Capping at INT_MAX and adding Sock::NO_TIMEOUT ensures portable socket waiting across macOS and BSD platforms."
    }
